name: Lymphoepithelial Cyst of the Pancreas

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and radiological diagnostic criteria for pancreatic lymphoepithelial cyst

criteria.description: Presence of cyst lined by stratified squamous epithelium with dense lymphoid tissue containing germinal centers
Well-circumscribed cystic lesion in pancreas with internal septations and absence of solid enhancing components on CT/MRI
Asymptomatic or mild abdominal discomfort without signs of systemic infection or malignancy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of cyst lining with lymphoid tissue plus compatible imaging findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Fine needle aspiration cytology may aid diagnosis but definitive diagnosis requires histology

pathognomonic.symptomName: Asymptomatic pancreatic cystic lesion detected incidentally
Palpable abdominal mass in epigastric region

searchTerms: jaundice caused by bile duct obstruction
skin and eye yellowing due to blocked bile

occasional.symptomName: Back pain localized to upper abdomen

rare.symptomName: Acute abdominal pain with cyst rupture
searchTerms: sudden belly pain from cyst burst
sharp abdominal pain with cyst rupture

rare.symptomName: Infection of cyst causing abscess formation

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated serum amylase and lipase
Absence of tumor markers elevation (CA 19-9, CEA usually normal)
imaging: Well-defined cystic lesion with internal septations on CT/MRI
No solid enhancing nodules within cyst
Ultrasound showing hypoechoic cyst with internal debris
other: Histopathology showing squamous epithelial lining with dense lymphoid tissue containing germinal centers
Fine needle aspiration cytology showing keratinaceous debris and lymphocytes

distinguishingFeatures: Lack of epithelial lining on histology
Usually benign with characteristic central scar

redFlags: Onset of jaundice or biliary obstruction
Presence of solid enhancing components within cyst on imaging
references: Adsay NV, et al. Lymphoepithelial cysts of the pancreas: a clinicopathologic study of 12 cases. Am J Surg Pathol. 2002.
Kamisawa T, et al. Lymphoepithelial cyst of the pancreas: a rare benign cystic lesion. Pancreas. 2011.
Orphanet: Lymphoepithelial cyst of the pancreas (ORPHA:697132)
